title: qr-graph impact line
description: One URI the invalidation reaches through the declared graph, breadth-first, each reached once by its shortest path. Follow `by` back to the start to explain the line.

via.description: `target`: the URI asked about. `refresh`/`purge`: a target of the write method asked about. `embed`: embeds `by`. `dependsOn`: its onGet() declares #[DependsOn] on `by`.

role.description: For an `embed` line whose `by` is a donut-cached page: `material` (the page reads this child, so its tags are stored with the page) or `hole` (rendered per request, left out of the stored template's tags). Source-text heuristic; absent for non-donut pages.

cached.description: Whether the resource declares a cache at all. Tags reach a parent only from a child that already ran, carrying an ETag (the non-donut path), or an ETag or Surrogate-Key (donut materials; holes have not run yet), so an `embed` line whose `by` is not cached is a dependency the cache may not track (for a donut page, a hole rendered per request). A `by` reached via `dependsOn` is the exception: its declared tags reach the page that embeds it whether it is cached or not.

source.description: file:line; null for a URI no scanned resource serves.
